content.text:
Done. Three speaker cards rendered at exact pixel sizes:

| File | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | Master — header, speaker row (circle + name/role), title, footer bar |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | Two columns — copy left, 420px portrait with name/role right |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | Centered vertical stack, 348px portrait, largest title |

**Build:** `build.js` generates the three HTML files from one shared design system (tokens per size), rendered with `playwright screenshot`. Inter is loaded via `@font-face` from the local TTF with `font-display: block` so nothing screenshots in a fallback face.

**Defects I found and fixed during review:**
1. **Landscape name wrapped** — "Maya Okonkwo-Lindqvist" broke at the hyphen into two lines. Widened the right column 400→600px and set the name `nowrap`.
2. **Square title under-filled its column** — `text-wrap: balance` was pulling lines ~240px short of the measure, leaving a weak ragged edge. Switched left-aligned titles to `text-wrap: pretty` and kept `balance` only for the centered story title, where it belongs.
3. **"on-call" broke across lines** in the square, reading like a hyphenation artifact. Wrapped it (and the surname) in `white-space: nowrap` spans.
4. **Slack whitespace** — redistributed into larger type: square title 60→68px, landscape 66→74px, story 76→80px; portraits enlarged to 172/420/348px.

**Verification:** `check.js` re-opens each page in Playwright and asserts programmatically — document and column overflow (scrollWidth/scrollHeight vs. viewport), every text element inside the frame bounds, pairwise bounding-box intersection across all non-nested elements, internal clipping, and that the portrait box is exactly square with `border-radius: 50%`. All three report **0 defects**. A JS auto-fit pass also shrinks the title if it would ever overflow, so the layout degrades safely rather than clipping. I confirmed each PNG visually as well.
